title: Poder personal
goal: Read how a caudillo's power actually worked day to day, through José Antonio Páez — a personal network of favors and loyalty, not a bureaucracy.

items: Explain how a caudillo governed differently from a modern official.
Explain why Páez was recognized as a leader by the llaneros.
Describe how the 'pyramid of overlapping loyalties' functioned.
Explain why patronage relationships were unstable.
Use passive voice to describe how favors, posts and land were distributed.
